description: This PHP class 'Upgrade19' is part of the OpenCart installation upgrade process. It handles the upgrade to version 19 by preparing a JSON response, managing error exceptions, setting success messages, constructing redirect URLs, and returning a JSON output.

classes.name: Upgrade19
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing the upgrade process to version 19 of the OpenCart system, extending the base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked to perform upgrade actions, handle exceptions, set JSON response, and redirect the user.
